status: stage S0 fixed before any fit; the main study's windows, splits and holdout are fixed in a later version of this file before any read of the capture, recorded in changes
question: does a small MDQR (a queue-reactive book whose intensities come from a neural network of the state, after Bodor and Carlier, arXiv 2501.08822v1) fix what #286 found for the fitted QR model (transient, queues climbing to the cap, worse than its constant baseline on queue TV) without artefacts, and do #102's policies transfer to it
approval: design note v0 (bus 61956), approved with changes (bus 61960): the Hyperliquid capture is the main data, synthetic QR days only as stage S0; K = 3 with the gap from the paper's 5 stated; current QR and its constant baseline are the controls, without waiting for #290; #102's policies transfer at their own execution
paper_gap: the paper models 5 limits a side on FGBL futures, MLP 256-64 tanh, sizes 1 to 200; here K = 3 (the replay's declared depth, #263), MLP 128-64 tanh, sizes 1 to 64 in event-size units, and in S0 the truth's own 2 limits; no code was released with the paper, so this is a reimplementation from its text

s0.purpose: a control on synthetic data where QR is the truth: MDQR fitted on the truth's events must recover it, before any fit on the capture
s0.data: SYNTHETIC: the queue-reactive simulator at #102's calm parameters (experiments/m4_06/design.json, pinned below), not market data

seeds.rule: fixed here before any run; a window is one run of the simulator from a book drawn from the invariant laws

model.mechanics: the queue-reactive book of src/backtest/queue_reactive.rs: an event moves one queue by one event size; a mid move while the opposite first queue is empty moves the reference with probability theta, shifts the queues one limit with the event-size renormalization, and redraws the book from the invariant laws with probability theta_reinit; the same xorshift64* generator, so that with the truth's own intensities the model is the simulator event for event (a test)
model.intensity: an MLP 128-64 tanh of the state to the log intensities of the 3 kinds x 2 sides x 2 limits; an intensity is 0 where the state forbids the event (a cancel or market order on an empty queue, a limit order on a full one)
model.state: log(1 + queue) of each queue (4), the spread in ticks, the kind of the last event at each queue (one-hot, 4 x 4 with none), and the time since the last event at each queue, log(1 + seconds); no hour, since S0's windows have no time of day
model.sizes: every S0 event moves a queue by one event size, so the size head is not used in S0; it is fitted on the capture only
model.clock: continuous: S0's events have distinct times, so the block clock with the end-of-block token, needed for the capture's block-tied times, is not used in S0
model.mechanics_parameters: theta, theta_reinit and the invariant laws estimated from the training windows (the share of eligible moves that moved, of moves that redrew, and the queue sizes at the samples, per limit, sides pooled)
model.fit: maximum likelihood of the marked point process: for each event, log intensity of the event at the state before it, less the total intensity times the time since the previous event; Adam, learning rate 0.001, minibatch 4096, 8 epochs over the training windows' events, float64, torch with 1 thread
model.simulation_seeds: the evaluation windows' seeds, so each model window is drawn as the truth's window of the same index is

s0.comparison: compare_trajectories (src/backtest/queue_reactive.rs) of each model or truth_again window against the evaluation window of the same index, at flow_interval_ms; per window and per training seed
s0.stop_rule: MDQR passes S0 if, for every training seed, its mean over the evaluation windows of the queue size TV at each limit, and of the flow law TV for each kind, is at most the truth's self-discrepancy (truth_again against evaluation, the same mean) plus 0.05; else the study stops and reports that MDQR cannot recover the truth
s0.compute: 0 job slots: CPU torch, 1 thread, in this window's share; an estimate is recorded after a timing pilot of one seed on one window

main_study.status: not fixed yet: its version of this file comes before any read of the capture and after S0 passes
main_study.data: the Hyperliquid BTC capture of December 2025 (Zenodo 18184441) through the replay at the declared depth K = 3 and tick 1 (#263), the Protocol split of hyperliquid_validation, declared windows per training day, extracted only from those windows' members
main_study.arms: QR as fitted (#90) and its constant baseline (#286); Hawkes (#91) and Poisson; MDQR-small at K = 3 with 5 training seeds
main_study.clock: block level: the total intensity is the block rate, and events inside a block are a sequence closed by an end-of-block token, so no event is dropped
main_study.generative_metrics: queue size TV by limit, spread TV, waiting KS, flow law TV, coverage, best bid and ask queue correlation, P(kind | queue, limit) TV, next mid move balanced accuracy, gamma shape of queue sizes, events at the cap
main_study.transfer: #102's frozen arms in each generator's rows at #102's own execution: 10 s rows, the rational queue at 1 lot per 5000 ms, min_queue 0 (bus 61960); before any run, a classical arm fills and its net differs from immediate fill

stop_rules.S1: on validation, MDQR is discarded if it produces NaN or more than 1 % of its events at the cap in 24 simulated hours
stop_rules.S2: adopted only if on the holdout its queue TV beats QR and the constant baseline at every limit with intervals excluding zero, no dependency metric is worse than QR's interval, and the transfer rank tau against QR is at least 0.6

main_study.seeds_and_bootstrap: MDQR 5 training seeds; simulation seeds declared; 2000 replicates, mean block 2, seed declared
main_study.compute: 2 job slots once #107 B frees them (bus 62495); any change in the job count announced on the bus

changes: 2026-11-08, design version 1 committed after one timing pilot and before any other S0 run: training seed 1 fitted on all 4 training windows (1309561 events) in 23 s on 1 thread, rather than one seed on one window as the compute line says; its fit was seen (log-likelihood per event by epoch, theta 0.604, theta_reinit 0.196, cap 4) and nothing else, no simulation and no comparison. The estimate: fit about 25 s a seed, so S0 needs no job slot.
